title: Check the format bounds 3296H and 6592H
body:
## Summary
- A field of 1,024 components bounded by `H` has Euclidean norm at most `32H`, since `32² = 1024`. The published row `ℓ1` norm 103 then gives the field bound `103 · 32H = 3296H`.
- The four-term numerator has coefficient norm 2, so the scratch bound is `2 · 3296H = 6592H`.
- `3296 < 2^12` and `6592 < 2^13`. With a sign bit, guard 7 gives signed widths `b+20` and `b+21`; guard 6 gives `b+19` and `b+20`. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
